Description: RukPay table. Three kinds of item share it, told apart by the PK prefix. VAULT#<id> with SK = META holds one cooling-off vault. HIST#<payer> with SK = E#<time>#<id> holds one payment history event. BENE#<payer> with SK = B#<id> holds one saved recipient. No secondary index. On-demand capacity. DynamoDB TTL removes items once expires_at (Unix epoch seconds) has passed.

TableName.Description: Value for the DYNAMODB_TABLE_NAME environment variable.
